# The external suites' fast subset, for pull requests (external-smoke.yml):
# programs that took 10 seconds or less on the simulated RTX 3060 in the
# nightly's first runs, spread over each suite. Columns: suite | a regular
# expression of the names (the list's first column) to run. (cudaGraphsPerfScaling
# is left out: it needs NVTX's headers, which the CI image does not carry.)
cuda-samples|/(vectorAdd|simpleAWBarrier|fp16ScalarProduct|simpleOccupancy|scalarProd|dct8x8|streamOrderedAllocation|simpleCudaGraphs|simpleVoteIntrinsics|simpleCooperativeGroups|simpleSurfaceWrite|threadFenceReduction|MC_EstimatePiP)$
hecbench|^(adam|attention|backprop|bscan|crc64|floydwarshall|gaussian|hausdorff|jenkins-hash|matrixT|merge|f16atomic)-cuda$
rodinia|^(pathfinder|needle|lud|streamcluster)$
polybench|^(2DCONV|3DCONV|BICG|GESUMMV|GEMM|JACOBI2D|ADI)$
